title: OWN-SERVICE-PROPS
description: What one microservice declares about ITSELF. Generated from core/service-props/service-props.decl.mjs — do not edit by hand.

id.description: typed name of the service; the closed list of first segments of a source path

api.description: public API address, `<domain>` as a placeholder — the registry is the same on every server, the domain is not

about.description: what the service does, in English, for a human and for a model

price.description: price, or null when it is not sold

for_sale.description: whether it is offered for sale at all

subdomain.description: its own subdomain, or null when it answers over the loopback only

manage.description: where a person configures it, or null when it has no page of its own

topics.description: word stems that mean «this request is about that service»; read by the router of foreign requests

channels.description: direct addresses in messengers; `{}` means the service said it has none yet

telegram.description: a Telegram bot of this service: { bot: "@name", url: "https://t.me/name" }
